One dog only, no text, letters, logos or watermarks, no extra limbs. Depict a respectful traditional portrayal of Jesus with shoulder-length dark hair, beard, compassionate expression and modest flowing robes with one boxer. Dog's face prominent and recognizable, both subjects clearly visible.
